profile.headline: Software Developer (Staff Engineer) at StoneX Group Inc.
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with skills in multiple languages.  I am computer literate in a variety of technologies and software applications. I primarily work using C# and SQL in my current work.  I have worked in different industries, including financial, health insurance, and agriculture.

I have worked in projects which were developed using SDLC, SCRUM, and TDD.  I have prior experience with existing system infrastructure, web-based applications, mobility web services, and team collaboration.  I have a strong work ethic and technical knowledge that enable me to work on various types of projects.  I have a passion for learning excellence in software development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Working as a software developer. Currently maintaining and creating new projects in C#. Projects include working with Windows services, MVC, MongoDB, Sql Server, and other technologies. Software commonly used are Git, Wrangler, Visual Studio, and a few other technologies.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as a Software Developer Consultant. Worked on multiple projects using Java, C#, and other localized languages. Performed work on enterprise infrastructure, web services, and mobile solutions for clients. Consulting roles include:

C#/Java Developer:
Implement software solutions for infrastructure and new technologies.
Used Java/Spring framework for web framework.
Used C# for back-end service for data creation and data storage functions.

C# Developer:
Implement software solution for mobile web services.
Used .NET C# to create framework.
Analysis of current infrastructure and project specifications for service calls.

positions.title: Application Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Worked as an Intern. Work included application development for new projects and maintenance on existing systems. Skills and languages used include:

Used Java and SQL for system infrastructure.
Used XML/XSLT, Javascript for work on information mapping.

positions.title: Temporary Employee
positions.description:
Worked as a temporary employee to meet contract deadlines. Performed computer imaging, data retrieval, and distribution of hardware on new computers. Tasks for job included:

Opening and repackaging hardware after computers imaged.
Distribution of hardware to client sites after imaging.
Hardware installation at client sites.

positions.title: Store Clerk
positions.description:
Developed customer service oriented skills through customer assistance and as a clerk.
Performed basic accounting duties with daily sales and reports.
Coordinated with team with donations and operated forklift for loading/unloading trucks.
